workspaces.description: Top-level tenant/organisation unit; all data is scoped to a workspace

users.description: CRM users (sales reps, managers, admins) who belong to a workspace

teams.description: Groups of users within a workspace, each optionally managed by a user

roles.description: Permission roles that can be assigned to workspace members

user_workspace_memberships.description: Junction table linking users to workspaces with an assigned role and team

accounts.description: Companies or organisations tracked in the CRM (prospects, customers, partners)

contacts.description: Individual people tracked in the CRM, optionally linked to an account

contact_account_links.description: Many-to-many junction linking contacts to additional accounts beyond their primary account

leads.description: Unqualified inbound prospects; can be converted to contacts, accounts, and opportunities

pipelines.description: Sales or process pipelines that group stages and opportunities

pipeline_stages.description: Ordered stages within a pipeline, with win/loss flags and probability

opportunities.description: Deals being pursued, linked to an account, pipeline stage, and owner

opportunity_stage_history.description: Audit log of stage transitions for each opportunity

assignments_history.description: Tracks reassignment of any entity (lead, contact, opportunity, etc.) from one user to another

products.description: Product or service catalogue items with pricing

opportunity_products.description: Line items linking products to opportunities with quantity and pricing overrides

quotes.description: Formal price quotes sent to accounts, optionally tied to an opportunity

quote_items.description: Individual line items within a quote, each referencing an optional product

tasks.description: To-do items assigned to users, linked to any CRM entity via polymorphic reference

activities.description: Log of all interactions (calls, emails, meetings, notes) against any CRM entity

notes.description: Free-text notes attached to any CRM entity, optionally private to the author

attachments.description: File attachments uploaded against any CRM entity or note

emails.description: Email messages sent or received, linked to a CRM entity and optionally threaded

email_participants.description: From/to/cc/bcc participant entries for each email, linking to a contact if known

calls.description: Phone call records linked to a CRM entity and optional contact

messages.description: SMS, WhatsApp, chat, and other channel messages linked to a CRM entity

tickets.description: Customer support tickets linked to an account and/or contact

ticket_comments.description: Threaded comments on a support ticket from users or contacts

tags.description: Colour-coded labels that can be applied to any entity type

entity_tags.description: Many-to-many junction assigning tags to any entity (lead, contact, account, etc.)

custom_fields.description: Schema-level definitions for user-defined fields on any entity type

custom_field_values.description: Per-entity values for custom fields, typed into separate value columns

lead_score_events.description: Incremental scoring events that build up a lead's total score

integrations.description: Third-party integrations configured per workspace (e.g. Slack, Stripe, HubSpot)

webhooks.description: Outbound webhook endpoints subscribed to workspace events

workflow_rules.description: Automation rules that trigger actions when entity events occur

imports.description: Bulk import jobs for loading contacts, accounts, leads, or products from files

dedup_rules.description: Configurable deduplication rules for matching leads, contacts, and accounts

merge_history.description: Record of entity merge operations, tracking which record was absorbed into which

audit_logs.description: Immutable audit trail of all create/update/delete/merge actions by users
